findings.title: Grafana list items rendered without a React key
findings.body: In the `rules.map` switch in `FilterViewResults`, the `'grafana'` branch now returns `<GrafanaRuleListItem ... />` without a `key` prop. Every other branch (`'datasource'`, default) still passes `key={key}`. The loop already computes a stable `key` (getRuleKey) and the old `GrafanaRuleLoader` was passed `key={key}`, so this is a regression. A `map` that returns elements without keys triggers React 'Each child in a list should have a unique key' warnings and forces reconciliation by array index, which can cause stale state/misrendering when the list grows or reorders. Add `key={key}` to the `GrafanaRuleListItem` element.

findings.title: Federated rule-group detection silently removed from useAllAlertRuleAbilities
findings.body: The refactored (deprecated) `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities(rule.rulerRule, groupIdentifierV2)`. The old implementation computed `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` from the CombinedRule's group; the new shared `useAllRulerRuleAbilities` hardcodes `const isFederated = false;` (with a TODO) because it only receives a rule and a group identifier, not the group's `source_tenants`. As a result, federated Mimir/Metrics-Enterprise rule groups (which must be treated as immutable) are no longer marked immutable in any caller of `useAllAlertRuleAbilities`, so the UI will offer Edit/Delete/Pause for rules that the backend considers read-only. This is a behavioral regression for existing consumers that still use this hook.

findings.title: Delete action is never shown for Grafana rules in the ruler-less list view
findings.body: The Delete menu item is gated on `canDelete && rulerRule` (`handleDelete(rulerRule, groupIdentifier)`). In the new list view (`RuleActionsButtons.V2`, used by `GrafanaRuleListItem`), only `promRule` is passed and `rulerRule` is always `undefined`, so the Delete item never renders even though `canDelete` is now correctly computed from the prom-rule abilities. This means users can no longer delete Grafana-managed rules from the alert list (the GrafanaGroupLoader test that grants `AlertingRuleDelete` and asserts only 4 menu items confirms it). `RuleActionsButtons.V2` already ignores the arguments and calls `showDeleteModal(identifier, groupIdentifier)`, so the `rulerRule` requirement in this gate (and the `handleDelete` signature) should be relaxed to use the identifier for the list-view path if delete is meant to remain available.

findings.title: View link no longer carries returnTo for Grafana rules
findings.body: The `href` for the rule is built as `createRelativeUrl('/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view')`, dropping the `returnTo` query parameter that the previous `GrafanaRuleLoader`/`GrafanaRuleListItem` added via `createReturnTo()` (`createRelativeUrl(path, { returnTo })`). Consequently, navigating from the rule list/group view into a rule's detail page loses the origin, so the detail page's back navigation no longer returns the user to the filtered/hierarchical list. If the returnTo behavior is still desired, the `returnTo` parameter should be restored.
